title: In 2019, Ryan Reynolds reportedly acquired a 25% stake in Mint Mobile; T-Mobile's deal valued at up to $1.35B may have earned him at least $300M | Hollywood
text:
How the $1.35 billion deal came about
T-Mobile announced the deal on March 15, 2023. T-Mobile said $1.35 billion was the maximum price, with the final amount depending on Ka'ena's performance before and after closing. About 39% would be paid in cash and 61% in shares. The headline figure was a cap, not a guaranteed payout. Other Ka'ena brands, including Ultra Mobile and Plum, were also included in the sale. Mint founders David Glickman and Rizwan Kassim were set to run those brands as a separate business unit within T-Mobile. T-Mobile said it would leverage its supplier relationships and scale to help the brands offer competitive pricing and a wider selection of devices.
